scripts.typecheck: bun run check:run bunx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.format: bun run check:run bun run tool:biome check --write . && bun run check:run bun run tool:dprint fmt
scripts.lint: bun run check:run bun run tool:biome ci .
scripts.format:check: bun run check:run bun run tool:dprint check
scripts.spell: bun run check:run bun run tool:cspell --no-progress --no-must-find-files .
scripts.verify: bun run check:run --stack bun run tooling/scripts/verify.ts
scripts.verify:plan: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/verification-report.ts
scripts.tools:install: bun run tooling/scripts/install-tools.ts && bun run apps/infra/src/cli.ts tools
scripts.openapi:check: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/openapi-check.ts check
scripts.openapi:update: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/openapi-check.ts update
scripts.skills:build: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/build-skills.ts
scripts.kb:record: bun run check:run --stack bun run tooling/scripts/record-kb.ts
scripts.docs:build: bun run check:run --stack bun run tooling/scripts/build-docs.ts
scripts.docs:reference: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/generate-reference.ts
scripts.sdk:generate: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/generate-sdk.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun run check:run bun run tooling/scripts/run-tier.ts unit
scripts.test:integration: bun run check:run --stack bun run tooling/scripts/run-tier.ts integration
scripts.test:e2e: bun run check:run --stack bun run tooling/scripts/run-tier.ts e2e
scripts.test:coverage: bun run check:run --stack bun run tooling/scripts/run-coverage.ts unit integration
scripts.bench:stack: bun run check:run --stack bun run tool:stack-bench
